newsitem.title: USA: IBM sets stock split, dividend.
newsitem.headline: IBM sets stock split, dividend.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp. said Tuesday it would split its stock 2-for-1 and declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of 35 cents a share before the split.
The world's largest computer maker said its board had approved the stock split subject to shareholders approving an increase in the number of authorized common shares.

IBM's stock, which had fallen in recent sessions after the company last week reported fourth quarter earnings that disappointed Wall Street, bounced back and rose $6.75 to $152.50 in active New York Stock Exchange trading.
The stock is one of the most widely held by individual and institutional investors worldwide and is one of the 30 issues in the Dow Jones industrial average.

IBM said last Tuesday that earnings rose 18 percent to $2 billion, or $3.93 a share, in the quarter, but several analysts said they were disappointed by sluggish mainframe sales and other factors. Before the report, IBM's share price had doubled in the last year or so.

The company said the board proposed raising the number of authorised common shares to 1.875 billion from 750 million. It said the record date for the split was May 9 and that the split shares will be distributed on May 27. It also said its annual shareholders meeting will be held on April 29 in Dallas.
